original_complete_fact.claim: HandlerHashSymbol uses a keyed handler first then conditional insertion order. get/add/trigger normalize a non-Symbol responding to id, not arbitrary strings; add replaces a key, copy resolves and shares the current handler object. trigger passes normalized id first; absent handler yields nil. actual_complete_meaning: 原get/add/trigger都规范化和子类resolve registry两处陈述不能原样采用。查找[]与trigger仅把非Symbol且respond_to id的输入换成其id；任意String不to_sym。add直接保存原sym键，不做该转换；addIf的sym是条件条目的登记键，匹配在后续查找依插入序进行。

无handler的trigger返回nil，调用时normalized id在参数首位；回调自身异常没有统一捕获。正式注册/复制以符号键的既有用法不被这份证据更正改动，不从内部Hash工具事实要求未来API。
